fact: The National ICT Policy 2019-2024 provides for a National Data Center, in Monrovia with replicas in the counties, to hold the storage needs of all ministries, agencies and commissions hosted there, as a cheaper option than each entity building its own.
title: Liberia Information and Communications Technology (ICT) Policy (2019-2024)
publisher: Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications, Republic of Liberia
